headline: Arrow Greentech: Substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Arrow Greentech Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE detailing a substantial acquisition of shares and possible change of control event under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011.
detail: The disclosure filed with NSE on 6 July 2026 signals a substantial acquisition event at Arrow Greentech. Under SEBI's Takeover Regulations, 2011, a Regulation 31(4) disclosure is mandatory when a person acquires shares crossing the 25% threshold or effects a change of control. The specific acquirer identity, consideration, and timing details are not disclosed in the reference document abstract, requiring review of the full PDF filing.
